GeneDef.label: Scoured Mind
GeneDef.description: They have seen the true nature of the Samhaphage and the value of a single human life has withered away. This gene marks those whose hearts have 'gone silent.' They can watch a friend fall or a stranger burn with the same detached curiosity one might feel watching a sunset. They are not cruel because cruelty requires an understanding of pain. They are simply empty.

GeneDef.label: null-thrum
GeneDef.description: The carrier’s skeletal structure has been 'harrowed' to vibrate at a frequency below human hearing. This constant, rhythmic thrum is the voice of the Sovereign Stillness. It drowns out individual thought and physical pain, leaving only a hollow, vibrating peace. And an emptiness that no amount of blood and meat can fill.
